title: Name the real wait
when: When a user or agent identifies a prerequisite at start, integration, delivery or closeout.
need: Dependencies can gate starting, merging or closing; the condition may be item completion, merge or delivery to a named environment. Coordination-only overlap creates no wait.
surface: Intake dependency inference; Frontier reason text and dependency detail
gap: Review question: should JOURNEYS teach the actual wait when the user states it, rather than expose every edge type up front?
surface_notes: Always encode item blockers as proper dependency edges so that the system knows when things move to ready.
